map_line.line: Hey there, explorer. Tap any building to check details.
Need directions? Pick a building and hit Navigate.
The map zoom is your friend. Pinch in and out anytime.
I can only show two bubbles at once. Keep tapping me.
Building cards open above the map when you choose an action.
If a route image exists, you will see it in Navigate view.
Try selecting another building to compare locations quickly.
I am here whenever you need a campus map hint.
